senses.gloss: a receptacle for drippings fastened (or belonging) to the bottom of a vessel, saucer.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 10:71">Mikv. X, 71</cite> <he>בלא ז׳</he> if the vessel to be immersed has no saucer (a rim at the bottom, wider than the belly of the vessel and which forces the water into the latter); (Var. <cite ref="G00269"><he>זִיבּוּרִית</he></cite>, <he>זוּבְרִית</he>, <he>זִיבָּרִין</he>). [Rabad to Maim.
<cite ref="Mishnah Mikvaot 3:12">Mikv. III, 12</cite> reads <cite ref="G00665"><he>זַרְבּוּבִית</he></cite> q. v.].
